blocks.html:
This method updates a service zone in a fulfillment set. It sends a request to the
[Update Service Zone](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#fulfillment-sets\_postfulfillmentsetsidservicezoneszone\_id)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The data to update in the service zone.

children.name: name
children.description: The service zone's name.

children.name: geo_zones
children.description:
The service zone's geo zones to restrict it to
specific geographical locations. You can update
existing ones by their IDs or add new ones.

children.name: country_code
children.description: The geo zone's country code.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the geo zone to update.

children.name: type
children.description: The geo zone's type.

children.name: province_code
children.description: The geo zone's lower-case [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO\_3166-2) province code.

children.name: city
children.description: The geo zone's city.

children.name: postal_expression
children.description: The geo zone's postal expression or ZIP code.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the fulfillment set.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.
